<thought>Search the template catalog for retrosynthetic templates that correspond to the Peterson reaction. In the forward reaction, a carbon‑silicon bond (trimethylsilyl) and an aliphatic hydroxyl group are broken, and a C‑C double bond is formed. Use these functional group criteria with the target molecule.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["trimethylsilyl", "aliphatic hydroxyls"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds"],
    "limit": 10
}</action_input>
